params.body:
The corpus on the Overview was folded under "The corpus · Show topics, coverage, geography and live activity", and once opened it spoke an older interface: a treemap in hard-coded warm greys with 10px labels, a steel-blue map in a white card, and two geography lists in white cards, each with its own heading style.

Now it is a section like "What is moving":

- **Heading** `The corpus` (text-lg 700) with one line under it: how many signals were read, by topic and by place.
- **Topics**: bar rows in two columns (name, count, a 3px aqua bar), each opening the signals for that topic, with "all signals" on the right as "all N" sits on the lists above. The thin-coverage line stays under it.
- **Coverage by region**: the map without its card (`GeoHeatMap bare`), on a scale from the ground (`raised`) to the Observatory's aqua (`cool`) instead of the steel blue from the dark years. Its hover tooltip had a near-black ground under ink text; it is white now. The compact maps on Insights, Patterns and Buffer keep their card and title.
- **What the signals are about / Where the sources are**: the two geography lists unboxed, under the same list heading as the rest of the page, side by side on a desk and one under the other on a phone (`.corpus-cols`).
- **Live activity** under its own heading; the empty sentence no longer repeats "Live activity:".

The `.fold-section` CSS is gone, since nothing else used it.

Checks: build OK, e2e 49 of 49. eslint reports the same three errors on these files as on main (none new).

params.title: The corpus on the Overview opens as a section, in the Observatory's own look
